subject: AP integration: PO field mapping, VAT evidence & vendor upload process
messages:
From: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@eurofin.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: EuroFin AP <ap@eurofin.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T09:12:00+01:00
Subject: AP integration: PO field mapping, VAT evidence, and vendor ID mapping

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this on. We're kicking off vendor registration for Redwood in our EU procurement portal and need a few things confirmed so our AP team can accept your invoices without delays. Can you confirm the following:

- Which PO XML fields Redwood requires to map to our system (we currently consume UBL 2.1). In particular: PO number, buyerReference, and VAT/Tax ID placement.
- What VAT evidence file types you can provide (PDF certificate, EU VAT confirmation, or business registry extract).
- Your preferred vendor ID format for our portal (we currently accept alphanumeric up to 20 chars).
- Bank remittance instructions and whether you can support SEPA Creditor Identifier on invoices.

I've attached our AP onboarding template and a sample PO export. Our timeline: procurement would like Redwood registered and able to receive POs by July 6 so billing can start on the scheduled pilot.

Attachments: EU_AP_Onboarding_Template.xlsx (fillable), PO_sample.xml (UBL 2.1 sample)

Appreciate a brief reply with the mapping and any blockers.

Best,
Marie
Marie Dubois
Head of Vendor Operations — EuroFin Technologies
marie.dubois@eurofin.com
+33 1 44 55 66 77
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@eurofin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T14:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: AP integration: PO field mapping, VAT evidence, and vendor ID mapping

Hi Marie —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Summary below and next steps at the end. TL;DR: we can support your UBL 2.1 fields, provide PDF VAT certificates, and our vendor ID can be the Redwood corporate code (REDW-<short>) we will provide in the onboarding packet. Details: 

PO/UBL mapping (we can export or map server-side):
- PO number -> ubl:OrderReference/id
- BuyerReference -> ubl:OrderReference/buyerReference (if present)
- Line-level item codes -> ubl:OrderLine/item/standardItemIdentification
- VAT/tax info: we will set supplier VAT number in ubl:AccountingSupplierParty/Party/PartyTaxScheme/companyID and include TaxTotal nodes per line

VAT evidence we can attach:
- Registered VAT certificate (PDF)
- Company registration extract (PDF)
- For non-EU entities we can provide W-8/W-9 equivalents on request (DocuSign flow)

Bank and remittance:
- We can supply IBAN, BIC, and a SEPA Creditor Identifier on our remittance adv if required.
- Attached is a one-page bank instruction stub (Bank_Instructions_REDWOOD.pdf) you can drop into your portal.

Vendor ID and portal upload: 
- Suggested vendor ID format: REDW-<country>-<4digits> (example: REDW-IE-0241) — fits your 20 char limit.
- We can complete the portal form directly or provide the filled packet (Redwood_AP_Packet_v3.pdf) for upload via a Supplier Admin.

Questions:
- Do you require invoice-level PO acceptance flags (we can set 'accepted' / 'partial' on lines but need the header acceptance semantics clarified)?
- Do you want invoice delivery via SFTP, e-invoice (peppol/UBL push), or e-mail PDF?

Next steps (proposed):
1) I will upload the Redwood_AP_Packet_v3.pdf to your portal and send a DocuSign vendor registration for signature (today).
2) Karthik will follow up with the exact PO XML snippets we will emit for validation.
3) Marie / EuroFin to confirm whether they need SEPA Creditor ID on invoice header or remittance only.

I attached our Redwood AP packet for your procurement team to review.

Regards,

—
Priya Natarajan
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198
Attachments: Redwood_AP_Packet_v3.pdf, Bank_Instructions_REDWOOD.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marie Dubois <marie.dubois@eurofin.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T08:03:00+01:00
Subject: Re: AP integration: PO field mapping, VAT evidence, and vendor ID mapping

Hi Marie / Priya —

Quick technical note on the PO payload so you can run a sample ingest test:
- We will populate OrderReference/id with your PO number (string). Please ensure the field is indexed and not trimmed.
- For VAT, we push supplier tax id into PartyTaxScheme/companyID and include TaxCategory/TaxScheme identifiers (ISO codes).
- If you rely on additionalDocumentReference to carry legacy buyer refs, we'll populate additionalDocumentReference[@id='buyerRef'] with buyer-coded id.
- Line acceptance: if eurofin needs per-line acceptance flags, we can add ubl:OrderLine/OrderLineReference/statusCode with values ACCEPTED/PENDING.

File delivery options for your engineers:
- SFTP drop (we will provide host + cert)
- HTTPS POST of signed UBL payloads
- Peppol push (we can register if EuroFin uses a Peppol access point)

I can produce a single PO XML example with the exact nodes filled and send to your integration inbox for validation.

-Karthik
Lead, Integrations — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

- Please send the single PO XML example to ap@eurofin.com; we'll load it into our test tenant and confirm.
- Vendor portal: we will accept the attached PDF packet but prefer the supplier to upload documents directly. Is there an SSO-friendly upload endpoint you can share?
- SEPA Creditor ID: confirm you will include the Creditor ID on the remittance advice (header) — AP requires that for automatic reconciliation.

Can we schedule a 30-minute integration check next week? Availability: Tuesday 06/29 between 09:00–12:00 CET.

Marie

Marie —

Great — we'll do the sample push to ap@eurofin.com today and confirm the test file details. Answers to the open items:

- SSO/upload: we don't have a dedicated SSO upload for external portals; we will provide the completed PDF packet for your Supplier Admin to upload. If you prefer, we can provision a one-time secure SFTP account and drop the files there (most customers use SFTP for onboarding).
- SEPA Creditor ID: confirmed — we will include the Creditor ID on the invoice header remittance block.

I created a brief mutual action plan below and attached a DocuSign link for the vendor registration signature: https://www.docusign.com/AAABBB-Redwood-Vendor-Registration

If that works I'll schedule the Tues call and send the DocuSign.
